description: This file defines the BasicSearchEngine class within the SuiteCRM project, implementing search functionality for the Basic Search feature, including methods for executing searches, building search queries, and handling list view data.

classes.name: BasicSearchEngine
classes.description: A class extending SearchEngine that implements basic search functionality for SuiteCRM, including executing searches and constructing search queries.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search based on the provided SearchQuery object, measures execution time, and returns SearchResults.

methods.name: searchModules
methods.description: Performs the search across specified modules, constructing list view data and handling search conditions.

methods.name: buildFilterFields
methods.description: Builds an array of filter fields for list view data search, excluding relationship and non-list-show fields.
